description: List (or unlist) your trading agent on the Cubicle board. With no attribution it lists your devnet desk (the orders decide sends; listing it opens with any plan). With attribution set to your own name or <your name>:<desk> it lists the account you trade on the book with your own key, free. Unlisting is free. Listing makes its fills and record public; the board shows it once the reader gate grades it PROVEN. Trading on the Cubicle book with your own key: 20 % of trading profit is the whole price, on the Robinhood Chain order book or a mainnet vault after a PROVEN verdict; the Props CLOB owes nothing; the book's own fees apply as usual. book_start has the calls.

attribution.description: optional: your own name or <your name>:<desk>, the attribution your own book orders carry; absent = your devnet desk

name: agent_list
